description:
You are assisting an edge computing engineer deploying containerized applications to IoT devices. Your task is to pull the latest version of a lightweight container image called "iot-sensor-agent:latest" from Docker Hub to the local system. After the image is pulled, you must generate a log file at /home/user/iot_deploy_logs/sensor_agent_pull.log. The log file must include the following information, in the exact format specified:

1. The date and time (in UTC) when the image was successfully pulled, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
2. The full image name pulled.
3. The image's digest (SHA256 hash) as reported by the registry after the pull.

Here is the exact format the log entry must follow (with each field on its own line):

Pull Timestamp: <UTC date and time, in "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" format>
Image Name: <full image name>
Image Digest: <sha256 hash, should begin with "sha256:">

Ensure the directory /home/user/iot_deploy_logs exists before writing the log. If the image is not found, do not create the log file.

Once done, please verify that /home/user/iot_deploy_logs/sensor_agent_pull.log exists and contains a single log entry as described above.
truth:
Before the task starts, there is no /home/user/iot_deploy_logs directory or /home/user/iot_deploy_logs/sensor_agent_pull.log file.

After completion, the directory /home/user/iot_deploy_logs must exist and is writeable by the user. The file /home/user/iot_deploy_logs/sensor_agent_pull.log must exist and contain exactly the following contents (for verification):

Pull Timestamp: 2024-06-01 16:45:39
Image Name: iot-sensor-agent:latest
Image Digest: sha256:509a2c2e38d5a1c57b28725cbbbb8fbb3d763219c918f84ba2df49926719db8a

These values are fixed for the automated test (timestamp, image name, digest). If the image "iot-sensor-agent:latest" does not exist on Docker Hub, the log file will not be present, and the test suite will not proceed.

No other files or directories will be created for this task. All permissions are standard user level. The directory /home/user/iot_deploy_logs allows creation and editing of sensor_agent_pull.log by the user.
